item.title: RuView: WiFi-Based Pose Estimation and Contactless Vital Signs
item.description: The ESPectre post, earlier in this series, uses WiFi CSI to answer “is anyone moving in the room?” RuView wants more: not just motion, but 17 body keypoints, breathing rate, heart rate, and through-wall sensing, all decoded from the same signals. It is written in Rust by ruvnet (the author of claude-flow), MIT-licensed, and with 92,000+ stars as of September 2026 it is the hottest open-source project in this space.
